notes: Urgent correctness fix for v0.49.0/0.49.1: the broader SMS parser was misreading bank/fintech PROMOTIONAL messages (pre-approved loan offers, insurance cover amounts, cashback promos) as real transactions, since marketing copy uses words like "paid"/"credited" loosely and often comes from real bank sender IDs. Added a promotional/marketing filter (same treatment as OTP messages - recognized and skipped, not recorded) plus a sanity cap so an implausibly large amount is never silently auto-inserted from the unverified generic path. If you already have a wrong large transaction in your ledger from 0.49.0/0.49.1, delete it manually from the Ledger, or use Clear All My Data and Log Out to rebuild your ledger fresh from SMS with this fix in place - also includes the v0.49.1 scan-speed fix.
